chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ قَالَ:

translations.en: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih from Abu Ubaydah, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ أُمُّ وَلَدٍ وَ لَهُ مِنْهَا غُلَامٌ

translations.en: I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who had an umm al-walad, and he had a boy from her.

chunks.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا حَضَرَتْهُ ٱلْوَفَاةُ أَوْصَى لَهَا بِأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ أَوْ بِأَكْثَرَ لِلْوَرَثَةِ أَنْ يَسْتَرِقُّوهَا

translations.en: So when death approached him, he bequeathed for her two thousand dirhams or more, to the heirs, that they should enslave her.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «لَا بَلْ تُعْتَقُ مِنْ ثُلُثِ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَ تُعْطَى مَا أَوْصَى لَهَا بِهِ».

translations.en: So he عليه السلام said: "No; rather, she is to be freed from one-third of the deceased's estate and given what he bequeathed to her."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding an umm al-walad at the death of her master. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rules that she is to be freed from one-third of the deceased's estate and is also to receive the amount bequeathed to her, rejecting the instruction that the heirs should keep her enslaved.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling on an umm al-walad if her master bequeaths wealth for her and orders the heirs to enslave her?

key_terms.أُمُّ وَلَدٍ: a slave woman who bore a child for her master
key_terms.ٱلْوَفَاةُ: death; the approach of death in the context of a final bequest
key_terms.أَوْصَى: he made a bequest or testamentary instruction
key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: a monetary unit; here referring to the amount bequeathed
key_terms.تُعْتَقُ: she is to be set free
key_terms.ثُلُثِ: one-third; the portion of the estate from which the ruling is carried out
